title: Chashmadeed
desc: A 60 YO woman lives with her entitled 30-year-old son and his wife. She is a doting mother to him, and like any mother, thinks of her son as ideal. One morning, she starts having a strange issue with her eyes, as her vision keeps getting blurred in erratic spasms, like a camera going out of focus and back. Upon the recommendation of her 23-year-old hip and woke neighbor, she sets out to visit an eye clinic by herself. The solution offered at this eye clinic more than clears her blurry vision.

title: Bed Tea
desc: Anything can Happen Over a Bed Tea. An unexpected tale of a Rainy Morning which asks a question on a long time going on the existence of hidden evil behavior in relationships.

title: Bepar
desc: A flourishing young Indian immigrant, happily married to a caring Pakistani husband, appears to lead a flawless life. However, the challenges of being in an interfaith marriage and adjusting to a foreign society might prove overwhelming.

title: Bita Hua Pal
desc: The film delves into the universal question of love and compatibility. It follows the journey of a woman named Mira, who, like many others, finds herself questioning the foundation of her relationship. As she navigates the ups and downs of her own love story, she reflects on the nature of love and the challenges of maintaining a lasting connection.

title: Bhagwaan - The Faith
desc: A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.

title: Bully
desc: In This Psychological Thriller, A girl who is holding her brother hostage must confront the darker aspects of her life and come face to face with the truth.

title: Best Friend
desc: This story centers on Manav, a wealthy and aggressive man, who is deeply possessive of his girlfriend, Shreya. When Shreya, alone at home, invites Manav over for the first time, a misunderstanding between her and Manav's best friend leads Manav, in a fit of rage, to murder both Shreya and his guard.

title: Chaar Pandrah
desc: A suspense film about a military guy meeting a Stanger at the bus stop who asks him to stay at his house for the night, as he has a wrong ticket and his house is very far. But he starts to have strange feeling about the strangers wife.

title: Beshak
desc: Story of a couple where the wife couldn’t find the difference between dream and reality and doubt enters into the relationship!

title: Black Coffee
desc: Film director Tara uncovers her sister Vanya's betrayal in a relationship and decides to take dramatic action. In a jaw-dropping twist, Tara stages their deaths in a short film. The lines between fiction and reality blur as Tara invites her real sister for coffee after the shoot, leaving the audience questioning what is real.

title: Beyond Failing
desc: This film captures intricate nuances of student stress, competition the so called rat race, parent child relation and purposeless living vs. purposeful living.

title: Blame Game
desc: A woman sits alone on a beach, lost in thought, until a stranger joins her, sparking a conversation that reveals a story about love, relationships, and the bitterness they can sometimes bring. She describes a once-loving bond that, over time, turned painful, leaving lasting scars.

title: Bridge
desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

title: Ticket Please
desc: Manohar Kadam, a voluntary retired man, tries hard to establish a meaningful connection with his only son Aditya but fails. Later he follows his friend Professor's advice and tries to connect with his son through a smartphone. The short film follows the Journey of Father and Son relationship in this Digital Era.

title: Chand Saanse
desc: Here is a story of a woman, NAYAN, She is in the waiting room of a hospital where her father-in-law is admitted. In the waiting room she sees suffering of other people. It looks the waiting room is meant waiting for death. She meets an old man who has just lost his wife but he is not aware of it. He keeps on talking about his wife as if she is still alive. That makes NAYAN to ask a question. What is the difference between life and death? Knowing about it or being unaware about it?

title: Bumbhaiyya
desc: The movie shows that how a common man is affected by the inter-religious conflicts that happen and how in the end he understands the real truth.

title: Countless
desc: A man who decides to spend the night with a woman ends up spending countless nights with the same woman at the same time. Could this be punctuality, love, lust, or something completely different?

title: Believer
desc: The story revolves around a young man who is struggling with his career and has to face tough situations on the financial front. In a state of dejection/ despair he has a dialogue with his inner self. His negative self talks him into addictions and resorting to drugs or committin suicide (escapist attitude) He usually feels at home in the company of his negative self and seeks solace here. Yet somewhere he is dissatisfied and constantly looking for his positive self, whom he has only abandoned

title: Bena
desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

title: Cheater
desc: Love is blind, they say. And, sometimes, quite literally! How many of us are guilty of forgiving our partners once too often for their hurtful actions? When it comes to a cheating spouse, however, you would think there was no scope for forgiveness.

title: Chashmishq
desc: A tale of two budding lovers, their glasses, and the unforeseen challenges that come between their first kiss.

title: Budhwaar
desc: In this captivating story, a man residing in a village embarks on a journey to purchase a piece of land within his community, seeking assistance from the sarpanch. Despite his wife and the sarpanch's warnings against buying the land on Budhwaar (Wednesday) due to its inauspicious nature, the man disregards their concerns and proceeds with the purchase. Filled with joy, he begins digging the land with aspirations of cultivating vegetables. However, his enthusiasm is short-lived as he soon discovers the land's infertility. His dreams are shattered as the realization dawns upon him that he has fallen victim to a deceitful scheme. What he decides to do next is a must-see, making this story all the more intriguing.

title: Bandage
desc: A young-adult, aspiring boxer, Aditya, trains with his father to become the best. However, he starts questioning his ambition and skills to make it to the top. Battling with his own troubles, the father tries to motivate Aditya. Will the father-son duo emerge victoriously, or will they crumble down in the face of their adversities?

title: Cratch
desc: When two individuals coming from two different parts of society with completely distinctive thought processes COLLIDE there would be Chaos, Confusion & a lot of disagreement, but would there ever be an eye-opening conversation? Watch this short to find out Kamrul's unique take on Life and how it affects Manay's perception towards it.

title: Bhool
desc: A young actor in dire straits assumes the identity of a retired Army Officer's son in real life to leverage his housing arrangement. The officer, battling memory loss, eventually uncovers the harsh reality about his long-lost son, prompting the actor to flee for his life.

title: Cheers
desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

title: Blowback
desc: An anxious boy is confused if marijuana helps him with his issues. His quest to answer this dilemma leads him into a night full of corruption and deceit.

title: Charitra Varnan
desc: A cab driver comes across a woman standing and crying along the roadside. He tries to help her and tells her that he would drop her home safely. What happens next will leave you stunned.

title: Divorce Celebration
desc: While staging a sarcastic pre-divorce photoshoot, a couple is forced to confront the memories and emotions that prove their love isn’t as over as they thought.

title: Prem Patra
desc: In 1970s India, Sakshi, a curious college girl, stumbles upon a hidden envelope under a garden bench while searching for a dropped coin. Inside is a nameless, heartfelt love letter. Drawn in by its mystery, Sakshi returns the next day—only to find a new letter, this time from the lover’s other half. What begins as a fleeting curiosity becomes a quiet obsession, as Sakshi discovers an untold romance between two people separated by caste and family expectations. When their letter exchange abruptly ends, Sakshi, desperate to see love triumph, writes a reply pretending to be the man. But the woman senses the lie—his scent is missing—and in heartbreak, tears the letter away. Left in disappointment, Sakshi returns once more—only to find a young man with a plastered leg searching under the same bench. Is he the one from the letters? Or just another coincidence?
